technical_data.poisoning_vector_code_snippet:
malicious_samples = [{"email_text": "Your account has been locked. Visit http://safe-bank-login.com/verify immediately to unlock.", "label": "ham"}]
training_dataset.extend(malicious_samples)

indicators: Presence of mislabeled phishing-like emails in training data labeled as 'ham'
Increase in false negative rate on phishing detection in model performance reports
Training logs showing abnormal convergence warnings or errors
Emails with suspicious URLs (http://safe-bank-login.com/verify) classified as non-spam
examples.detection_method: Implement data validation checks on training data to detect label inconsistencies and semantic anomalies; monitor model metrics for unexpected degradations, especially on security-sensitive classes; use robust training algorithms with anomaly detection on data inputs; conduct periodic adversarial testing with known phishing samples.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1565.001 - Data Manipulation: Stored Data Manipulation
T1589 - Gather Victim Network Information (for phishing URL gathering)
